subsystems.name: Data pipeline
subsystems.role: collects and curates the demonstrations from which the model learns.

subsystems.name: Model architecture
subsystems.role: a transformer that turns camera images and instructions into motor commands.

subsystems.name: Training infrastructure
subsystems.role: runs the large-scale distributed training that builds the model.

subsystems.name: Embodiment adapter
subsystems.role: maps the model's outputs onto the kinematics of different robot bodies.

subsystems.name: Evaluation and safety layer
subsystems.role: tests performance and prevents dangerous actions.

subsystems.name: Deployment runtime
subsystems.role: executes the model on the robot with low latency.

buildSteps.title: Collect demonstration data
buildSteps.detail: Teleoperate robots to perform many tasks, recording camera views, joint positions and actions.

buildSteps.title: Add simulated and human video data
buildSteps.detail: Generate synthetic demonstrations in physics simulators and use internet videos to broaden visual and semantic knowledge.

buildSteps.title: Pretrain a vision-language backbone
buildSteps.detail: Train a transformer on large image-text datasets so it learns general visual and language representations.

buildSteps.title: Fine-tune on robot demonstrations
buildSteps.detail: Teach the model to output actions by training on the collected robot data.

buildSteps.title: Align action spaces across robots
buildSteps.detail: Normalise and map actions so one model can control different robot arms and grippers.

buildSteps.title: Evaluate in simulation and on real robots
buildSteps.detail: Measure success rates, generalisation to new tasks and safety, then iterate.

buildSteps.title: Deploy to a target robot
buildSteps.detail: Compile the model for onboard inference, connect to sensors and low-level controllers.

buildSteps.title: Update from field data
buildSteps.detail: Collect new demonstrations during use and periodically retrain to improve performance.

prerequisites.why: models need thousands of hours of diverse manipulation data, which are still being aggregated.
the same attention-based design that powers language models can map observations to actions.
simulators generate cheap data but still differ from reality in contact-rich tasks.
human operators must demonstrate tasks, and affordable rigs make data collection practical.
robots need enough local processing to run large models without cloud latency.
general-purpose robots must be provably safe around people before wide deployment.

pathway.milestone: single-robot, multi-task models demonstrated in research
pathway.unlocks: robots that can perform several household or warehouse tasks from one model.

pathway.milestone: cross-embodiment models that transfer between a few robot platforms
pathway.unlocks: faster deployment of new robots without retraining from scratch.

pathway.milestone: commercial pilots in warehouses and factories
pathway.unlocks: real-world data flywheel and proof of reliability.

pathway.milestone: general-purpose robots that learn new tasks from a handful of demonstrations
